observation.command:
cd /workspace/project && DISPLAY=:99 timeout 200 python3 - <<'PY' 2>&1 | tail -25
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b=p.chromium.launch(headless=False,args=["--no-sandbox"])
    pg=b.new_page()
    pg.goto("https://venice.ai/sign-up",wait_until="domcontentloaded",timeout=60000)
    pg.wait_for_timeout(6000)
    for inp in pg.locator("input").all():
        print("input:",inp.get_attribute("type"),inp.get_attribute("name"),inp.get_attribute("placeholder"))
    print("--- tombol ---")
    for bt in pg.locator("button").all()[:8]:
        print("btn:",repr(bt.inner_text()[:40]))
    print("--- script captcha ---")
    print("turnstile:",pg.evaluate("!!document.querySelector('script[src*=turnstile]')"))
    print("recaptcha:",pg.evaluate("!!document.querySelector('script[src*=recaptcha]')"))
    b.close()
PY
